Updating icu4c in OpenJFX:

1) Navigate to relevant release from https://unicode-org.github.io/icu/download/
   - Download the source bundle
     - example: https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/download/release-79.1/icu4c-79.1-sources.zip
   - Get the data package file name and sha256 value
     - example: https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/download/release-79.1/icu4c-79.1-data-bin-l.zip

2) Copy the files from common, common/unicode, i18n, i18n/unicode, stubdata and tools/toolutil directories.
   - Remove any files that were deleted in the upstream icu source
   - Remove Makefile.in and BUILD.bazel files.

3) Update java/data/data_as_asm.cpp as per the API changes in toolutil/pkg_genc.h

4) Retain the only one JavaFX specific change in the icu source file: common/unicode/platform.h
   (The linux build may fail without this change)

5) Update modules/javafx.web/src/main/native/Source/ThirdParty/icu/CMakeLists.txt:
   - Update ICU_*_SOURCES using sources.txt file.
   - Set ICU_DATA_FILE_NAME to the correct data filename: icudt*l

6) Update the ICU version in build.properties.

7) Update gradle/verification-metadata.xml to reflect the new data package artifact name and sha256 value.

8) In the source files:
   - Expand tabs to 8 spaces
   - Remove trailing white spaces

9) Make sure that the Line Endings are UNIX style for all the files.

10) Update the license files
   - modules/javafx.web/src/main/native/Source/ThirdParty/icu/LICENSE
     - Make sure that it matches with the upstream LICENSE file
   - modules/javafx.web/src/main/legal/icu_web.md
     - Update the version string at the beginning of file
     - Update the license text or notices

11) Verification: JavaFX sdk webkit build and all test run, on all supported platforms.
